```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

corona_topology <- read_tsv("tests/corona_both_combi/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")

hsv_topology <- read_tsv("tests/hsv_both_combi/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")

gprofile_reader <- function(type, path) {
  files <- list.files(
  path = path,
  pattern = paste0(type, "\\.sub_enriched_pathways\\.tsv$"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

transformed_names <- basename(files) %>%
  str_remove("\\.gprofiler2.*") %>%  
  str_replace("^([^.]+)\\.(.+)\\.([^.]+)$", "\\1_\\3")

datalist <- files %>%
  set_names(transformed_names) %>%
  map(~ read_tsv(.x))

data_list_combi <- datalist %>% imap_dfr(~ .x %>% mutate(source = .y))

return(data_list_combi)
}

corona_kegg_combi <- gprofile_reader("KEGG", "tests/corona_both_combi/evaluation/gprofiler/")

hsv_kegg_combi <- gprofile_reader("KEGG", "tests/hsv_both_combi/evaluation/gprofiler/")

hiv_kegg_combi <- gprofile_reader("KEGG", "tests/hiv_both_combi/evaluation/gprofiler/")

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)
```

```{r}

corona_topology <- corona_topology %>% 
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         fill_group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_"))

hsv_topology <- hsv_topology %>% 
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         fill_group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_"))

```

```{r}
hsv_topology %>%
  mutate(
    group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = method,
    y = nodes,
    fill = group,
    shape = group
  )) +
  # lines connecting human/virus within each dataset
  geom_line(
    aes(group = interaction(dataset, method)),
    position = pd,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  # points dodged by dataset
  geom_point(
    position = pd,
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    aes(group = dataset)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Seed/Dataset",
    labels = c(
      "human_hvidb" = "human, HVIDB",
      "human_intact" = "human, IntAct",
      "virus_hvidb" = "virus, HVIDB",
      "virus_intact" = "virus, IntAct"
    ),
    values = c(
      "human_hvidb" = "darkblue",
      "human_intact" = "lightblue",
      "virus_hvidb" = "darkblue",
      "virus_intact" = "lightblue"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Seed/Dataset",
    labels = c(
      "human_hvidb" = "human, HVIDB",
      "human_intact" = "human, IntAct",
      "virus_hvidb" = "virus, HVIDB",
      "virus_intact" = "virus, IntAct"
    ),
    values = c(
      "human_hvidb" = 22,
      "human_intact" = 22,
      "virus_hvidb" = 24,
      "virus_intact" = 24
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9))

ggsave("plots/hsv_module.jpeg", width = 6, height = 4)
```

```{r}
corona_kegg_combi %>% 
  filter(Pathway_code == "KEGG:05171") %>%
  mutate(seed = ifelse(str_detect(source, "human_seeds"), "human interactors", "viral interactors")) %>%
  mutate(source = str_remove(source, "human_seeds\\_|virus_seeds\\_")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Fraction_DE, y = source, fill = Padj)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  facet_grid(seed ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#C60C12", high = "#F6656A") + 
  labs(title = "Modules which identified SARS-CoV-2 disease pathway",
       x = "Enriched Fraction")
```
